in_marathi.name: Girika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain loving, mountain goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', meaning mountain. This name is often given to a baby girl born in the hills or mountains. It is also believed to be a tribute to the mountain goddesses, Parvati and Shiva's consort, Annapurna. In Hindu mythology, these goddesses are revered for their nurturing, protective, and motherly qualities.
